summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K to furnish unaudited interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with an earnings release, investor presentation, and correction of a prior net loss per share figure. This is a routine periodic financial reporting by the issuer, not a special situation. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are mentioned. The filing provides financial data and operational updates. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a quarterly earnings update under US securities law.
